exclusion_reason: spawn stubs with MISSING quality_score (no agent work completed)

pre_registered_hypotheses.question: Are compass quality gates well-calibrated for observed agent quality_scores?
pre_registered_hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Gate thresholds sit at reasonable percentile boundaries (SEED admits ~90%, DEEPEN ~70%, EXTEND ~40%, FULL ~20%)
pre_registered_hypotheses.result: REJECTED — 3 of 4 gates TOO EASY (pass rates far exceed targets)

pre_registered_hypotheses.question: Does quality_score vary by investigation_label?
pre_registered_hypotheses.result: INCONCLUSIVE — parametric (F=2.66, p=0.052) says NOT SIG, non-parametric (H=13.6, p=0.018) says SIG; methods disagree

pre_registered_hypotheses.question: Does belief_index correlate with quality_score?
pre_registered_hypotheses.result: REJECTED — Pearson r=0.54 (p=3.6e-5), Spearman rho=0.78 (p<1e-6); LARGE positive correlation; both methods agree

pre_registered_hypotheses.question: Do compass bearings correspond to gate logic?
pre_registered_hypotheses.result: REJECTED — Fisher exact p=0.0005; perfect separation (0/3 below-gate got S, 47/49 above-gate got S)

quality_score.distribution: NON-NORMAL (left-skewed with one extreme outlier at 0.30)

bayesian_update.interpretation: Gates likely need recalibration (posterior < 0.5 under uninformative prior)

correlation_quality_belief.interpretation: Strong positive correlation — high-quality agents also self-report more honestly

limitations_and_caveats: quality_score and belief_index are self-reported by agents, not independently verified
Phase field missing from majority of manifests (only 18/52 have explicit phase)
No FULL-phase samples available for direct gate validation
The vault-crystal-scout-3 outlier (quality=0.30) drives non-normality; without it, distribution is more symmetric
quality_score distribution is left-skewed; current population is HIGH-performing, which inflates pass rates
ANOVA vs Kruskal-Wallis disagreement on STAT-QG-002 suggests sensitivity to distributional assumptions
what_would_change_conclusion: If future sessions produce quality_scores with mean ~0.70 (closer to theoretical midpoint), gates would appear better calibrated
If quality_score self-reporting is independently validated and found inflated, suggested thresholds should adjust downward
Multi-day measurement (3+ sessions) with diverse investigation_labels would increase confidence in percentile-based suggestions
If FULL-phase samples accumulate with quality < 0.85, the FULL gate may be correctly calibrated despite appearing easy now
recommendation: Gates DEEPEN/EXTEND/FULL are too easy for current agent population. Suggested recalibration: SEED=0.78, DEEPEN=0.82, EXTEND=0.89, FULL=0.92. However, this recommendation should be validated across 3+ sessions before changing faerie2-formulas.json. The current population may be artificially high-quality (selection effect from single active day).
